Legal.title: Terms of Use
Legal.subtitle: Public offer for free use of the DuckTale website and network services

sections.heading: 1. General provisions
paragraphs: This document is a public offer under Articles 435 and 437 of the Civil Code of the Russian Federation and sets out the terms for free use of the website at {siteUrl} and its related services (the "Site"), including the DuckTale Minecraft network's game servers.

This is a courtesy English translation. The Site is operated under Russian law, and in case of any discrepancy between this translation and the Russian-language version, the Russian-language version governs.
The offeror (Site owner) is a private individual acting on their own behalf, without registered business (sole proprietor) status. Contact details are listed under "Details" below.

Registering on the Site, creating an account, linking a Minecraft profile, or otherwise using the Site constitutes full and unconditional acceptance of this offer under Article 438 of the Civil Code of the Russian Federation.
If you do not agree to these terms, please do not use the Site or create an account.

sections.heading: 2. Subject of the agreement
paragraphs: The offeror provides the user with free access to the Site's features: browsing information about the game servers and documentation, registering an account, and linking a Minecraft account to a Site account.
The Site and the DuckTale server network are not an official Mojang Studios or Microsoft product and are not affiliated with either company.
The Site and its features are provided "as is", with no guarantee of uninterrupted operation, preservation of in-game progress, or availability at any given time.

sections.heading: 3. Account and Minecraft linking
paragraphs: Using certain Site features requires registering with an in-game nickname and password.
The user is solely responsible for keeping their account credentials secure and for all actions taken under their account.

Linking a Minecraft profile is done by entering a one-time code, obtained on the Site, via an in-game command on a network server. The code is valid for a limited time and must not be shared with third parties.
The user may unlink their Minecraft profile from their account at any time, from their account page or via an in-game command.

sections.heading: 4. Personal data processing
paragraphs: When processing the user's personal data, the offeror follows Federal Law No. 152-FZ "On Personal Data" of July 27, 2006.

Data processed: in-game nickname, password hash (the password itself is never stored or shared), the UUID and nickname of a linked Minecraft profile, last login date and time, and technical data needed to protect the Site from automated abuse (such as per-IP request rate limiting).
Purpose of processing: identifying the user, operating the account page and the account-linking feature, and protecting the Site from abuse.
Data is not shared with third parties, except where required by the law of the Russian Federation.
The user may request deletion of their account and associated data by emailing the address listed under "Details" below.
Data is retained for as long as the account exists and is deleted on the user's request or if the Site ceases operation.

sections.heading: 5. Rights and obligations of the parties
paragraphs: The user agrees not to use the Site or related services for unlawful purposes, not to attempt unauthorized access to other users' accounts, and not to share their linking code with third parties.
The offeror may restrict or terminate a user's access to the Site or the game servers in case of a violation of the Site's or the DuckTale network's rules.
The offeror is not liable for interruptions to the Site or servers caused by technical failures, third-party actions, or force majeure.

sections.heading: 6. Changes to this offer
paragraphs: The offeror may amend the terms of this offer unilaterally. The current version is always available at this address, with the effective date shown at the top of the document.
Continued use of the Site after changes are published constitutes acceptance of the revised terms.
